NewsArticle.Title: Justice Updated
NewsArticle.Content:
Due to recent abuses of some Judicial powers, all justice officials will only be able to either Sgath or Exile someone once every Temuair day ((three hours)). Likewise, if a person is banished, at least one hour of real time must pass before they can be unbanishede.
Also, there has been some questions to actual Nexon policy of law within the game. To clarify some of the more common requests:
Nexon does not allow character sharing. Character sharing is when more than just the registered user plays on the characater. Now, it is no secret that there is a great amount of character sharing going on in Dark Ages and it has been the Game Director's choice not to strictly enforce this policy. However, if you give your password to someone else the following will happen:
No items lost will be returned.
No brands received and no punishment awarded to the character will be removed.
If the character causes severe trouble within the game - such as mass Exiles or Sgaths or massive profanity/harassment, the account of that character will be blocked without any possibility of restoration.
NOTE: If you give out your password and this happens, you have NOT BEEN HACKED. You have opted to compromise the security of your character and accept all reprocusions of that decision. Also, Nexon has many ways of telling if you have shared your password. Submitting a 'hacked' report on a character that you have shared the password on can result in the removal of that character and/or account blocks.
Please keep your character's password to yourself. Your character's security is in your hands and your responsibility.
Also, profanity, even if in code or with clever spellings, is considered harassing behavior. Please refrain from cursing.
